_note: Model capability catalog + per-shot routing policy. Keep model FACTS here, costs in pricing.json. The router (agents/model_router.py) reads 'routing'; clip_builder/image_generator read 'models' to dispatch a backend. Add a model by adding an entry under 'models' and listing its id in 'routing'.
_fal_endpoints_warning: fal.ai endpoint slugs and pricing shift monthly — VERIFY each fal_endpoint on fal.ai before the first paid run.

aura_sr._use: REAL person/footage — does NOT invent detail, so a real face stays the real face (moat-safe).

clarity_upscaler._use: AI stills / ambient B-roll — adds detail (hallucinates), NEVER route a real person here.

nano_banana_edit._use: Reference-conditioned generation — keeps a supplied face/character across a NEW scene. The strong identity path (real face-refs AND fiction characters). VERIFY the fal endpoint before a big run.

flux_kontext._use: In-context edit — holds a subject across scenes. Alternative identity model to nano_banana.

gpt_image_edit._use: OpenAI gpt-image-1 edit — the original identity/edit path, now the FALLBACK.

mmaudio._note: S30 Phase 2 SFX seam (galleri5-validated: their auto-SFX is what made clips feel finished). Video+text -> a synced atmosphere/foley track for one clip. VERIFY the fal endpoint slug + price before the first paid run (see _fal_endpoints_warning).

routing._note: shot_type → cost_tier → ordered preference list of model ids. Router picks the first id that exists in 'models'. 'real' (real photo/video at the video step) and 'passthrough' (real media at the image step) are handled in the router code.

video._kling_dead_note: KLING IS REFUSING WORK (verified live 2026-07-17): POST /v1/videos/image2video -> HTTP 429 {"code":1102,"message":"Account balance not enough"}. The API Platform is PREPAID-PACKS-ONLY — there is no pay-as-you-go tier, so with '2 packages purchased, 0 in effect' every Kling call fails. Both packs were trials (100Units depleted; 1000Units expired 2026-07-04 stranding 258/1000). Top-up is NOT self-serve — the dashboard offers only 'Contact us for purchase', so restoring Kling needs a sales cycle. Consequently the 2026-07-02 'kling_pro leads every premium lane to burn a prepaid Kling balance' hack is not just obsolete, it is actively harmful: it made every premium shot start with a doomed 429. Kling is therefore DEMOTED to last on every lane (kept, not deleted, so restoring a pack re-activates it with no code change). This restores the best-fit routing the hack's own revert note prescribed: landscape→hailuo, hero→seedance, dialogue→veo. TO RESTORE KLING: buy a resource pack via Kling sales, confirm `python -m agents.balances` shows a live pack, then move kling_pro/kling_std back up the lists.
video._higgsfield_first_note: 2026-07-17: higgsfield LEADS landscape+hero (its declared strengths: camera-move, cinematic) and sits 2nd on face. Why: (a) it is the only video backend with BOTH working code and live prepaid credit — fal is balance-locked and both Kling packs are dead, so every other premium video model is currently unpayable; (b) $0.10/5s is cheaper than kling_pro's $0.14. Verified live 2026-07-17 with a real DoP render: 74s end-to-end (NOT the 1.5-5min the agents/higgsfield.py docstring claims), 720x1280 true 9:16, 5.37s, 30fps, h264, no audio; identity held across the clip and the subject produced real motion (head turn + foreground parallax), not just a camera push. NOT added to 'real' (the render reframes/re-crops the source — unsafe for real-media preservation until tested on an actual photo) or 'dialogue' (no audio/lipsync strength). TO REVERT: drop 'higgsfield' from the lists below; the model entry + fallbacks can stay.
video._draft_note: kling_std ($0.08) WAS the entire draft tier — with Kling refusing, higgsfield ($0.10, prepaid credit already owned) is the only cheap draft option left. It is slower (~74s/clip, max_concurrent 4), which is the real cost of this; seedance/veo/hailuo are 3-5x pricier and wrong for iteration. kling_std stays last so a restored pack instantly reclaims the lane.

identity._note: Reference-conditioned generation (keep a supplied face/character in a new scene). Ordered failover — the edit path (agents/image_editor.edit_image) tries these in order. Override the primary with env IDENTITY_MODEL.

fallbacks._note: Gap #8 — per-model ordered alternates for vendor failover. Each chain prefers a DIFFERENT backend first so one vendor outage/price-spike degrades independently. The router (model_router.run_with_fallback) tries the primary, then these in order. Same kind only.
fallbacks._video_note: 2026-07-17: higgsfield inserted as the FIRST alternate on every kling/fal chain. Before this, the video chains only LOOKED cross-vendor: kling_pro -> [seedance, veo, kling_std] is two fal hops then kling, so with fal balance-locked AND both Kling packs expired there was no live path — a kling failure exhausted the whole chain. higgsfield is the only third video backend (own credit, own vendor), so it is what makes the '_note' claim above actually true for video.

_defaults_note: defaults[kind] is the LAST resort in select_model/candidates — it fires when a shot_type/tier has no routing entry. It pointed at kling_std, i.e. the one video vendor that refuses every request (2026-07-17), which turned the safety net into a guaranteed failure. Point it at a vendor that can actually bill.
